publication.plain: Supply atomic mass relative to proton mass, the fine-structure constant, light speed in meters per second, electron and proton masses in kilograms, a positive bulk prefactor and nonnegative shear-to-bulk ratio with identical nonempty shapes. Diagnostic speeds may exceed the reported upper scale; material applicability must be established separately.
